d:
I always said that Suki would never do an NNN, but other forms of her would in some way. This is the way nobody wanted!
In the Alternate Universe of "Suki: Futanari Tamer" where Suki is a woman and Leiko is a futanari, Tsukino "Suki" Kinboshi convinces Leiko "Futanaka" to partake in No Nut November.
